We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 5 reactions for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have guidance: steps enumerated forward: 1) TBS protection of alcohols (introduce TBS). 2) Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE) forming double bonds and carboxylic acid? Actually HWE forms olefins from aldehydes/ketones with phosphonate, giving E-alkene and carboxylic acid? The description: "as a result of the reaction, a carbon-carbon bond formed, while a carbon-phosphorus bond and a carbon-oxygen are broken. As a result, an 'aliphatic carboxylic acid', and 'C-C double bonds' groups are formed." So forward: aldehyde + phosphonate -> alkene + carboxylic acid (maybe unsaturated acid). 3) DIBAL-H reduces ester to aldehyde. 4) TMSOTf protects alcohols (makes TMS ether). 5) Still-Gennari (Z-HWE) forms double bond and carboxylic ester.

But we need retrosynthesis: we need to break down target into precursors via reverse of these steps. The target includes a free hydroxyl (maybe protected?) Actually target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O. Contains a primary alcohol (CO) side chain? Let's parse: There's a cyclic sugar-like core (maybe a tetrahydropyran) with two O substituents: one OH at position 1 (O attached to chiral carbon), and an O-alkyl chain O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C (that's an O attached to a side chain that includes a double bond and a CH2OH). Also there is a side chain C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O (a conjugated diene with terminal carboxylic acid). So overall many double bonds.

We need 5 retrosynthetic steps. Likely steps: 1) Remove TBS protecting group (if any). But target has no TBS; maybe earlier step had TBS protected alcohol that later deprotected. So retrosynthesis: target -> deprotected precursor (with TBS). So step 1: deprotect TBS (reverse of protection). Use template for breaking O-Si bond (functional group broken: t-butyldimethylsilyl). We have template ID from search: reaction_id 29646 with retro_smarts_template that converts [C:2]-[OH] to C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]... So forward is protection; retro is deprotection. So we can apply that template to target to get a TBS-protected intermediate.

Let's apply template 29646 to target.
